title: Modified variable queryClient to retry a failed query once

segments.title: Failed queries retry once
context: A page that loads data stopped loading after one failed request. The app now sends a failed request a second time before the page stops loading. One dropped request no longer leaves a shopper with an empty catalogue or without the profile form.

- **When** a shopper opens the catalogue and the first request for the products fails, **then** [the app sends the request a second time](code:src/lib/query-client.ts#queryClient), and the page shows "Loading the catalogue" until that request ends.
- **When** both requests for the products fail, **then** the page shows an empty list after two requests, where it showed that list after one.

- **When** a shopper opens the account page and the first request for the profile fails, **then** [the app sends the request a second time](code:src/lib/query-client.ts#queryClient), and the page shows the profile form when that request succeeds.
- **When** both requests for the profile fail, **then** the page shows "Your profile could not be loaded" after two requests, where it showed that text after one.
- **When** a request for the products or the profile fails with a status that a second request cannot change, such as 404, **then** the app still sends the request a second time.
- **When** the first request for the products or the profile succeeds, **then** nothing changes.
- **When** a shopper saves the profile and that request fails, **then** nothing changes.
- Modified [`queryClient`](code:src/lib/query-client.ts#queryClient) to set `retry` to `1` in its default query options, where it set `false`.

journeyNodes.label: Creates the query client with one retry per query
journeyNodes.description: When the app starts, `src/main.ts` imports this value and passes it to `app.use(VueQueryPlugin, { queryClient })` on line 12. `useProducts()` in `src/composables/use-products.ts` and `useProfile()` in `src/composables/use-profile.ts` call `useQuery()` in the app that uses that plugin and take its default options. No import and no call leads from this value to them, so the diagram draws neither.

waypoints.title: Modified `queryClient` to retry a failed query once
waypoints.reading: The author modified a constant `queryClient` that now sets `retry` to `1` in its default query options, where it set `false`. A query that fails now runs its query function a second time before it reports the error. `src/main.ts` passes `queryClient` to `VueQueryPlugin`, so that `useProducts()` in `src/composables/use-products.ts` and `useProfile()` in `src/composables/use-profile.ts`, which set no `retry`, send a failed request again. `useUpdateProfile()` in `src/composables/use-profile.ts` calls `useMutation()`, and the `queries` options do not apply to a mutation.
